Name: Sunflower Acres
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[size=3][b][color=#f1c232] ✿[/color][/b][b]  This mod adds a new farm called [/b][b]Sunflower Acres[/b][b] to your game!  [color=#f1c232] ✿[/color][/b][/size]

[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/r8SbSb4.png[/img][/b]



[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/jxl2K2T.png[/img][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Second cave with hot spring and non-seasonal crop patch [/b][color=#999999](optional)[/color]
[*][b]Quarry with ore spawns [/b][color=#999999](optional)[/color]
[*][b]Permanent fences with invisible animal barriers [/b][color=#999999](optional)[/color]
[*][b]Forage spawns, fish spawns, tillable grass
[/b]
[*][b]Minecart network throughout the farm[/b]
[/list][b] [/b]


[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/ydhpfAn.png[/img][/b]

[color=#999999][i][b]Customise the farm by editing the config.json file in the mod's folder or using the Generic Mod Config Menu.
If the config.json file is not there, run the game once so SMAPI can generate it.[/b][/i][/color]

[list]
[*][b]EnableCave[/b]
[*][b]EnableQuarry[/b]
[*][b]EnableDebris[/b]
[*][b]EnableDecorations[/b]
[/list][b]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/wpefvop.png[/img]

[/b][list=1]
[*][b]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿﻿[/b]
[*][b]Download this mod and place [i]both [/i]folders in Stardew Valley/Mods[/b]
[*][b]Start a new game and choose the Sunflower Fields farm
[/b]
[/list][b]
